entries.title: Psalms 65:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David: a Song.>> Praise waiteth for thee in silence, O God, in Zion; and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

entries.title: Psalms 65:2
segments: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

entries.title: Psalms 65:3
segments: Iniquities have prevailed against me: our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.

entries.title: Psalms 65:4
segments: Blessed is he whom thou choosest and causest to approach: he shall dwell in thy courts. We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, of thy holy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 65:5
segments: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation, thou confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of the distant regions of the sea. ...

entries.title: Psalms 65:6
segments: ¶Who by his strength established the mountains, being girded with power;

entries.title: Psalms 65:7
segments: Who stilleth the raging of the seas, the raging of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 65:8
segments: And they that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens; thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 65:9
segments: Thou hast visited the earth, thou hast watered it; thou greatly enrichest it: the river of God is full of water; thou providest their corn, when thou hast so prepared it:

entries.title: Psalms 65:10
segments: Thou dost satiate its furrows, thou smoothest its clods, thou makest it soft with showers; thou blessest the springing thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 65:11
segments: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness, and thy paths drop fatness:

entries.title: Psalms 65:12
segments: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness, and the hills are girded with gladness.

entries.title: Psalms 65:13
segments: The meadows are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, yea, they sing.
